items.title: Casa Vista's AQUORA on Dubai Islands 40% sold before official unveiling
items.summary: The Dh350m waterfront scheme of 105 residences and six retail units had sold 40% of its homes ahead of its Madinat Jumeirah unveiling on 28 October; handover is targeted for Q1 2028.

items.title: Nakheel awards Dh950m+ build contract for 617 Bay Grove homes
items.summary: Parkway International will build eight buildings with 617 one- to four-bedroom homes across Phases 2 (360 units) and 4 (257 units); completion is expected in late 2028 and Q2 2029 respectively.
